entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I... I need to make a return. I ordered a helmet and... it's just not right.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. To get started, could I have your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-012. I just feel so bad about this. I've been a customer for so long and I hate having to do this.
Thank you, I've pulled up your order. I see the helmet was delivered about a week ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's a preference, I guess. It's the color. I bought it as a gift and I just chose the wrong one. He won't wear it, and his old one isn't great, so his safety is really important to me. The box is still unopened, sitting right here. I really needed that money back for other gifts.
I completely understand, and no need to feel bad at all. Getting the right color is important. Let me just confirm our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I just hope it's possible.

Absolutely. I've just checked, and since the helmet was delivered only seven days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. You have no idea how much that helps.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
